title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-l9ck: fragmentation_vectors.rs tests not updated for from_bytes API change
description:
Commit 37159329 changed Fragment::from_bytes(data, out) to accept 2 arguments (adding out: &'a mut [u8]). But lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs still calls from_bytes with 1 argument at 3 call sites:

- Line 210: `let parsed = Fragment::from_bytes(&wire).unwrap();`
- Line 236: `let fragment = Fragment::from_bytes(&wire).unwrap();`  
- Line 373: `assert!(Fragment::from_bytes(&wire).is_err());`

These need a scratch buffer added: `let mut scratch = [0u8; TILE_SIZE + MIC_LENGTH + 1];` and passed as second arg, matching the pattern used at fragment.rs:860.
